facts: WarehouseMotion builds one reciprocal ORCA proposal with the robot as an agent, then tests actual fixed robot displacement separately.
admissible_fraction tests33 common scales1,31/32,...,0 of that one six-human displacement proposal.
Scaling human motion down is not assumed safe against an approaching robot; every candidate is swept-tested.
If none passes2mm gaps, it raises the measured terminal error. This is failure of the candidate family, not proof no feasible velocity exists.
root_cause_confidence: Source-confirmed limited proposal family; exact failed internal candidate velocities are not logged, so no claim about the unique cause of its infeasibility.
next_change: Add and test an alternative human avoidance proposal and prompt robot-stop handling in a new version; keep this baseline and frozen kernel unchanged.
